cc:Work.dc:description:
import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
# All amplitudes and basis vectors are supplied explicitly by the prompt. x = np.array([3, 1, 4, 2], dtype=float) basis = np.eye(4) components = x[:, None] * basis if not np.array_equal(components.sum(axis=0), x): raise ValueError("The weighted basis vectors must reconstruct the signal.")
ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786" colors = ["#33658A", "#2A9D8F", "#D4A72C", "#9273B5"]
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": ink, "axes.labelcolor": ink, "axes.edgecolor": slate, "xtick.color": slate, "ytick.color": slate, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.linewidth": 0.8, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.8, 4.2), dpi=100) fig.text( 0.5, 0.947, r"Standard basis decomposition in $\mathbb{R}^{4}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=16, weight="medium" )
bottom, height = 0.395, 0.405 left_rect = [0.067, bottom, 0.177, height] small_lefts = [0.326, 0.494, 0.662, 0.830] small_width = 0.126 axes = [fig.add_axes(left_rect)] axes.extend( fig.add_axes([left, bottom, small_width, height]) for left in small_lefts )
def configure_axis(ax, main=False): ax.set_xlim(-0.35, 3.35) ax.set_ylim(0, 4.5) ax.set_xticks(np.arange(4)) ax.set_yticks(np.arange(5)) ax.tick_params(axis="both", length=3, width=0.7, labelsize=9, pad=4) ax.set_xlabel(r"$n$", fontsize=11, labelpad=5) ax.spines["left"].set_color("#A7B0B5") ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#A7B0B5") if main: ax.set_ylabel("Amplitude", fontsize=10, labelpad=7) ax.set_axisbelow(True)
for ax in axes: configure_axis(ax, main=(ax is axes[0]))
# The original signal is neutral; color identifies the four individual terms. axes[0].vlines(np.arange(4), 0, x, color=ink, linewidth=2.2) axes[0].scatter(np.arange(4), x, s=38, color=ink, zorder=4) axes[0].set_title(r"Signal vector $\mathbf{x}$", fontsize=12, pad=13)
for i, ax in enumerate(axes[1:]): inactive = np.delete(np.arange(4), i) ax.scatter( inactive, np.zeros(3), s=23, color="#B6C0C5", edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.5, zorder=4, clip_on=False ) ax.vlines(i, 0, x[i], color=colors[i], linewidth=2.8, zorder=3) ax.scatter(i, x[i], s=43, color=colors[i], zorder=5) ax.set_title( rf"${int(x[i])}\,\mathbf{{e}}_{{{i}}}$", color=colors[i], fontsize=13, pad=13 )
# Operators occupy the whitespace between plots. operator_y = bottom + height * 0.48 fig.text(0.282, operator_y, r"$=$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=25, color=ink) for xpos in [0.473, 0.641, 0.809]: fig.text(xpos, operator_y, r"$+$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=22, color=slate)
def column_equation(center, values, prefix, color=ink): """Typeset a genuine four-entry column vector in figure coordinates.""" row_y = np.array([0.258, 0.220, 0.182, 0.144]) vector_x = center + 0.025 half_width = 0.014 cap = 0.005 y_low, y_high = 0.124, 0.278
fig.text( vector_x - 0.028, (y_low + y_high) / 2, prefix, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=12, color=color ) for value, ypos in zip(values, row_y): fig.text( vector_x, ypos, str(int(value)), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, color=ink )
for side in (-1, 1): edge_x = vector_x + side * half_width inner_x = edge_x - side * cap fig.add_artist(Line2D( [inner_x, edge_x, edge_x, inner_x], [y_high, y_high, y_low, y_low], transform=fig.transFigure, color=color, linewidth=0.9 ))
column_equation(left_rect[0] + left_rect[2] / 2, x, r"$\mathbf{x}=$") for i, left in enumerate(small_lefts): column_equation( left + small_width / 2, basis[i], rf"${int(x[i])}\times$", colors[i] )
fig.text( 0.5, 0.047, "Standard basis: one unit entry per vector; all other entries are zero.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color=slate )
